title: Refactoring UI - Transistor
text: Hey guys, welcome back to another edition of refactoring UI. In this episode, we're going to be taking a look at an example provided by my friend, Justin Jackson. Justin and his partner, John Buda, are building Transistor, a platform to host all of your podcasts on. It's a really great tool to manage your shows and grow your audience. I actually have a few friends who use Transistor for their podcasts and all they have to say is great things about it. So I was really happy to take a look at the design to see how it can be improved.
zh: 嘿，各位，欢迎回到又一期的“重构 UI”。在本集中，我们将要看看我朋友 Justin Jackson 提供的一个案例。Justin 和他的搭档 John Buda 正在开发 Transistor——一个用于托管你所有播客的平台。这是一款管理节目并扩大听众群体的绝佳工具。实际上，我有几位朋友都在用 Transistor 来运营他们的播客，而他们对此的评价都非常好。因此，我很乐意来看看它的设计有哪些可以改进的地方。
